choices.text: How do you know my name?

name.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
name.text: It's written on your face, beta. Like it was on Kishan's.

intro.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
intro.text: Deshmukh. 4B. I have been here longer than these walls.

ask.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
ask.text: I take a small walk at three. Kishan kept the little gate open for me. You will also, no?

choices.text: Sorry, sahab. The gates stay locked after midnight.
How long have you lived here, sahab?
Did Kishan say why he stopped coming?
Where do you go at three?

promise.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
promise.text: Good boy. Three-twelve. Don't be late.

years.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
years.text: Since the foundation stone. My wife chose 4B for the morning light.

years2.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
years2.text: She is gone now. The light still comes. Every morning, for nobody.

kishan.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
kishan.text: Kishan stopped asking questions. That was good of him.

kishan2.speaker: MR. DESHMUKH
kishan2.text: You ask a lot of questions, Raghu.
